name: Boa Vista
pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP2025 settlement point; not shifted to force a parcel hit and not a municipal-boundary or coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official municipal organizational page identifies the Departamento de Cadastro Imobiliário (DCI) under the municipal planning, finance and information-technology secretariat. Official citizen-service pages document cadastro imobiliário, cadastral-limits certificates, and lot registration. This is local custody evidence, not open citywide parcel geometry.
technicalBlocker: The current official municipal cartographic page exposes only 2016 and 2020 base-cartography PDF downloads. The municipal cadastral services are request/certificate workflows and do not expose a safe anonymous parcel feature response. The linked Matricula Online application is an education-enrollment application, not a cadastral viewer; its public shell exposes an authentication API and no parcel route was used.
